restart_policy: Retain source coordinates, box and velocities; change NVT to isotropic NPT, remove position restraints, restart thermostat/barostat random streams. No reminimization or velocity reinitialization. Extension time starts at zero.
limitations: Protein is an uncapped gamma fragment, not the newly prepared capped six-chain core
Short preparation stages, not established interface equilibrium
Finite PE oligomer model, no bulk crystal validation
Neutralizing ions only; no prescribed 150 mM salt
No binding/adsorption free energy or spontaneous-adsorption claim
Isotropic NPT is a finite-patch preparation protocol, not a validated macroscopic slab protocol.
